name: Aider
description: AI pair programming tool for terminal-based LLM collaboration
installInstructions:
Create wrapper script:
#!/bin/bash
export AGENT_ID=aider
aider "$@"; code=$?
if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then
  agent-notify completed "Aider session finished"
else
  agent-notify failed "Aider session failed (exit=$code)"
fi
